schedulingDecision.rationale: Authorized Phase 86 review, independent implementation work, and bounded remediation before final acceptance of Phases 75 and 81; Phase 86 status blocked pending independent review and physical Android hardware.

securitySuites.description: Findings register VR-001 through VR-008 regression tests, leakage prevention, and fail-closed gates
Argon2id bounds, AES-256-GCM AEAD envelope exchange, recovery secret wrap/unwrap, and KDF concurrency
Encrypted item models, checkpoint replay/freshness verification, and transfer-model safety
Vault session state machine, unlock attempt limits, cooldown timing, and enrollment
Web vault harness browser contracts, cross-tab lock coordination, and presentation masking

remediated.title: Stale or interrupted unlock operation recovery (30s timeout reset)
Cooldown counter reset on elapsed cooldown window
Mobile push notification privacy exclusion for vault destinations
Strict recovery secret canonicalization & error differentiation

gated.title: Large attachment streaming format unfinalized (libsodium secretstream proposal only)
Independent qualified external audit and physical Android device evidence unmet

leakageAndPrivacyVerification.serverStorageAndSync: Verified: Zero vault plaintext stored on server; sync payloads contain only ciphertext envelopes with canonical AAD
leakageAndPrivacyVerification.searchIndexes: Verified: SearchItemTypeSchema strictly limits indexed types to task, routine, journal, project, note; vault items explicitly excluded
leakageAndPrivacyVerification.browserCacheStorage: Verified: Service worker public/sw.js explicitly bypasses Cache Storage for all vault endpoints (/api/v1/vault/* and /vault/*)
leakageAndPrivacyVerification.mobileNotifications: Verified: scheduleLocalReminderAsync unconditionally redacts title/body for destination: 'vault' and targetType: 'vault'
leakageAndPrivacyVerification.aiAssistantContext: Verified: AI assistant tools, system prompts, and context builders filter vault records out of assistant ingestion
leakageAndPrivacyVerification.diagnosticsAndLogs: Verified: Redaction filters prevent passphrase, VRK, DEK, and recovery secret disclosure in application logs
